question: did aims students mentor limbe high schoolers in programming
answer: Yes — 10 students from GHS Limbe and GHS Bonadikombo attended the first of four mentorship sessions covering Python programming and personal branding, on 11 May.
evidence: 10 students from Government High School (GHS) Limbe and Government High School (GHS) Bonadikombo, Mile 4 in Limbe arrived AIMS Cameroon’s Centre of Excellence on May 11th for the first of four mentorship sessions
